The publication-disabled simulated-Actions build-core run and independent native-local build-core run reproduced the package, resolver metadata, and both ABI artifacts byte for byte. ARMHF logs are byte-identical. Parallel ARM64 output differs only in complete-line ordering; both logs share the exact line multiset and all four logs independently satisfy the fail-closed Genesis Plus GX base proof.

The pristine source is commit fa4dca561e08d5be9077419f7b255e1da213ed21, tree 7f4b0916e938e15e046e1c35acd0173aab1aaac3, with no submodules. The proof binds native leading-space version ` fa4dca5` to all 117 C compile commands per ABI, every source/object and complete compiler invocation, the exact ordered link, and binary version v1.7.4 fa4dca5. ARM64 retains exactly two reviewed warnings and one note; ARMHF is warning- and note-free.

Resolver metadata reports Non-commercial licensing, MS/GG/MD/CD content, twelve optional firmware files, core_options_version 2.0, full-path loading, disk control, and libretro saves. Spruce currently ships core-options metadata 1.0 and a config using legacy genesis_plus_gx_bram, while the candidate exposes system-BRAM, cart-BRAM, and cart-size settings. Upgrade behavior, Master System, Game Gear, SG-1000, Genesis/Mega Drive, Sega CD, BIOS and CD handling, BRAM and option migration, controls, audio/video pacing, saves, states, frontend integration, and sustained performance remain target-runtime gates.

The imported Spruce binaries identify as ARM64 f64e0a1 and ARMHF 252a94c rather than candidate fa4dca5, so byte reproducibility does not establish an in-place upgrade claim. Base-to-Wide and Wide-to-Base state compatibility are not proven and no cross-variant state claim is made.

Resolver metadata declares Non-commercial, while the root license prohibits sale or commercial activity, requires complete corresponding source for modified distributions, and includes separately licensed bundled components. The package contains neither corresponding source nor a license and notice inventory, so any public distribution or release remains a human legal and policy gate even though the local bytes reproduce.

Both builds clone the exact source over the network; no offline source bundle or network-disabled rebuild is proven. The portable toolchain archives and loaded image identities are locked, but cached images retain dockerfile_linkage=unverified-local-cache as an explicit provenance limitation.

ARM64 requires GLIBC_2.17 and GLIBC_2.29 and records the AArch64 loader, libc, and libm. ARMHF is EABI5 hard-float, reaches GLIBC_2.7, and records libc and libm. Provider compatibility is unverified. The portable artifacts bind only to ra64-universal-v1 and ra32-a30-v1; they do not establish ra32-universal-v0, Miyoo Mini, or Pixel 2 compatibility, and all device views remain ineligible pending provider and target-runtime evidence.
